description:
Designed with the lowest possible step-thru height, the Simple Step-Thru bicycle makes riding easier and safer. Coupled with the low-step thru the frame geometry also features a forward pedal design. The pedals are positioned approximately four inches forward from where they are located on a traditional bike frame. This gives you the ability to keep your seat low to the ground while pedaling and still get great leg extension.

Dismounting is a breeze, no more need to swing your leg over an unnecessarily high-top tube thus virtually eliminating the risk of falling or tipping over. Added safety features don’t mean reduced performance. Featuring smooth pavement and also hard-packed trails. The thicker tire size adds stability, again adding to the safety features while they also absorb more of the bumps and shocks on rides so your body doesn’t. The smooth and simple electric motor reduces the muscle exertion required to power your two wheels. You decide the workout you get, leaving your body as fatigued as you want it to be after completing your ride. Lastly, the riding position will situate you in an ergonomic position, relieving pressure on your wrists, shoulders, back, and knees. You will complete your rides with less pain and soreness, so you can accomplish your normal daily activities as usual. For added confidence and comfort, having the electric motor provides peace of mind knowing that if your body fatigues you have a backup power source to assist you. The smooth and simple electric motor reduces the muscle exertion required to power your two wheels. You decide the workout you get, leaving your body as fatigued as you want it to be after completing your ride.

Mounting and dismounting your bicycle made simple with the Simple Step-Thru hybrid electric bike. Designed with the lowest possible step-thru height the Simple Step-Thru bicycle makes riding easier and safer.

The pedals are positioned approximately four inches forward from where they are located on a traditional bike frame. This gives you the ability to keep your seat low to the ground while pedaling and still get great leg extension.

500 Watt Motor that functions either in pedal assist or full electric mode

Top speed of 20mph for both full electric and with pedal assist

Front and rear disc hand brakes for easy and prompt stopping

500 Watt Hour Battery that will take you 20 miles using full electric and 20 - 40 miles on pedal assist mode

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Labs
